personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for B2B Logistics with Editorial typography)
personality_one_liner: Modern, professional, and crisp B2B logistics with ample negative space and authoritative typography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a modern editorial feel. Inputs and buttons should be comfortably large for touch targets.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism for this clean, professional B2B app

screens.name: LandingPage
screens.purpose: Default entry point explaining DashLocal and providing clear entry routes.

states.error: Standard error prompt with retry button.

screens.layout: Mobile-first, responsive stack. Top Header: Vector SVG Logo + 'Track Order' CTA (Muted Gold or text link). Hero Section: Full-width hero image (delivery driver/storefront) with a subtle vertical gradient scrim to ensure text readability, bold Poppins heading ('Same-day local delivery for small businesses'), PT Serif subtitle. Bottom Sticky / Main Container: Primary CTA 'Merchant Sign-in' (Forest Green, full width), Secondary CTA 'Staff Sign-in' (Charcoal outline). Maintain ample negative space between the hero and action blocks.

screens.name: MerchantSignIn
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for business partners leading to their order portal.

states.error: Inline red error text above the CTA.

screens.layout: Clean, single-column form on a surfaceSecondary card over a surface background. Poppins heading 'Merchant Portal'. Standard Email and Password inputs with labels above (PT Serif). Forest Green primary submit button. Back button in header.

screens.name: StaffSignIn
screens.purpose: Dual-mode login for Admins and Drivers, routing to distinct dashboards.
screens.layout: Top segmented control or pill toggle (Admin / Driver). If Admin: Email + Password inputs. If Driver: Phone number + 6-digit PIN inputs. Primary CTA adapts based on toggle. Keeps the same generous padding and clean card-on-background structure.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the Logo strictly via react-native-svg: Combine a bold 'D' character (using a heavy sans-serif or path) in Forest Green (#2B8932) with a red (#E60000) upward-pointing polygon/arrow path cutting through its left stem. Alongside it, stack 'DASH' (Charcoal #333335) and 'LOCAL' (Red #E60000) in Poppins Bold. Wrap it in a scalable Svg component.

Brand colors and fonts (Poppins/PT Serif) are EXCLUSIVE to the Landing page and Sign-in screens. Do NOT touch the existing brutalist dashboards (which use SpaceGrotesk, JetBrainsMono, black/white, red).

Hero Image Implementation: Use the `hero_background` image from the JSON. Apply a top-to-bottom `expo-linear-gradient` scrim (transparent at 0%, 20% #333335 at 50%, 75%+ #333335 at 100%) layered over the image, placing the white Poppins headline over the darkest bottom portion of the scrim.

Track my order feature: Place a highly visible entry point (either a top right header button in Muted Gold, or a floating clean input field over the hero section) allowing customers to enter a tracking ID.
Form aesthetics: Use #F5F5F5 (Soft Gray) for input backgrounds or clean bottom-borders to maximize negative space. Keep labels above inputs, utilizing PT Serif for a trustworthy, established feel.
Ensure 'Staff Sign-In' relies on a state-based toggle (e.g., a simple pill switcher) rather than separate screens to keep navigation shallow.
